bindings.windows: WDF PnP function driver or applicable class family
bindings.linux: PCI driver registered for exact vendor/device/subsystem IDs
bindings.android: Linux PCI driver on supported SoC/platform plus Android vendor integration
bindings.macos: DriverKit only if the PCI family and API are supported
bindings.freertos: Board/SoC-specific PCIe host or endpoint controller and vendor HAL

virtualization: QEMU needs a model for the specific PCI function; a virtual PCI bus does not emulate arbitrary hardware.
